commits.message:
fix(markup): read an embedded string once per markup setting, and as Rich's render_str reads it (rich-markup-3sw)

Review round 1 (high):
- EmbeddedText caches each markup reading; a 500-row markup table printed
  9.3ms on master, 16.4ms re-parsing per call, 9.9ms cached.
- readStr replaces emoji codes with markup off, as render_str does, for
  print and every embedding site.
- EmbeddedText measures unhighlighted, as Rich's Measurement.get does, so
  measure and render agree wherever a container clears the highlighter.
- Column header/footer go through embed, so a header read off one column
  can be assigned to another; they take any cell content, as Rich's do.
- protocol's type-only Highlighter import is marked as the one tier
  exception; docs/highlighting.md states nested Columns/Rule draw plain.

fix(markup): a console's markup and highlight settings reach strings embedded in a renderable (rich-markup-3sw)

A string handed to a Panel, Table, Tree, Columns, Layout or Rule is now an
EmbeddedText, read when it is drawn through renderStr (Rich's render_str)
under RenderOptions.markup and RenderOptions.highlighter, which the Console
fills from its own settings and print's. An unmatched closing tag now throws
from the render, as Rich's does.

Which sites highlight follows Rich site by site: Columns items, Layout panes
and Rule titles are highlighted; Panel, Table and Tree strings are drawn
plain; a Panel's title and subtitle are always markup.

refactor(repo-facts): the docs build reads repo facts from scripts/, not test/ (rich-repo-facts-hss) (#253)

* refactor(repo-facts): the docs build reads repo facts from scripts/, not test/ (rich-repo-facts-hss)

REPO_ROOT, the package manifest, the entry-point map, the repo's compiler
options and listTypeScriptFiles move from test/coverage/extract.ts to
scripts/repo-facts.ts; resolveAlias moves to scripts/resolve-alias.ts.
Every importer reads them from the new home and extract.ts re-exports
nothing, so nothing under docs/ imports from test/ and a refactor of the
coverage verifier can no longer change how the docs' examples compile.

* refactor(repo-facts): path helpers join the repo facts; a gate keeps test/ out of non-test code (rich-repo-facts-hss)

Review pass (high) on PR #253:
- repoRelative, isPathInside, isUnderSrc and isBehindNodeAirlock move to
  scripts/repo-facts.ts, so the seam gates no longer import the coverage
  verifier for repo layout.
- test/seam/test-imports.test.ts fails when any .ts under src/, docs/,
  scripts/ or examples/ imports a module under test/.
- example-runner reads peerDependencies from PACKAGE_MANIFEST instead of
  parsing package.json a second time.
- resolveAlias no longer swallows a throw from getAliasedSymbol.
- tsconfig.scripts.json includes scripts/**/*.ts directly.
